summary: This is a draft for counsel's review, computed from the record with machine-checked lines. Of 24 key details, investigators introduced 5 first (one in part), 9 were already public, and 2 may trace to earlier conversations with no public transcript. The remaining 8 details appeared first from the suspect in the available transcripts. Investigators first named a knife, that the victim was shot in the head, and that Avery raised the RAV4's hood; the suspect adopted each after questions that named the detail. The suspect first stated she was tied up with rope, restrained on the bed in Avery's bedroom, and stabbed in the stomach, with no earlier transcript source for those details. Two details—bleach on his jeans from cleaning the garage floor and blood on the garage floor—may originate from an unrecorded evening conversation on February 27, 2006. One detail, a tattoo on her stomach, was raised by investigators but never adopted by the suspect.
